title: helpful fact_feedback raises trust and records an audit event
description: Proves the fact_feedback tool is wired end-to-end: a `helpful` action on a seeded fact must raise its trust_score above the seeded value and append a matching row to the memory_feedback_events audit table. Guards against a regression where feedback is silently dropped or stops moving trust.
contract_notes: Deterministic write-path check with no LLM. helpful applies +0.05 to trust_score (store.rs apply_feedback) and inserts a memory_feedback_events row with action='helpful'. The single seeded fact is fact_id=1 in the fresh fixture.

facts.content: Payments service exposes an idempotency key on POST /charges

assertions.name: feedback_target_fixture_loaded
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_facts WHERE source = 'feedback-target'

assertions.name: helpful_feedback_raised_trust_above_seed
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_facts WHERE source = 'feedback-target' AND trust_score > 0.3

assertions.name: helpful_feedback_event_recorded
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_feedback_events WHERE fact_id = 1 AND action = 'helpful'
